+"""Visual, proprioceptive controller for one Meta-World lever-pull episode.
+
+The service is the only source of scene state.  Run stages from the command line;
+each invocation reconnects to the same episode without resetting it.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+
+
+def state(obs):
+    p = obs.meta['proprio']
+    return dict(zip(p['layout'], p['now']))
+
+
+def capture(robot, label):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=list(robot.spec()['cameras']), include_depth=True)
+    for cam, rgb in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(rgb).save(OUT / f'{label}_{cam}.png')
+        np.save(OUT / f'{label}_{cam}_depth.npy', obs.depth[cam])
+    (OUT / f'{label}_meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    print(label, 'tcp', [state(obs)[f'tcp_{a}'] for a in 'xyz'],
+          'mocap', [state(obs)[f'mocap_{a}'] for a in 'xyz'],
+          'grip', state(obs)['gripper_opening'],
+          'steps', obs.meta['control_steps'], 'time_left', obs.meta['time_left_s'], flush=True)
+    return obs
+
+
+def move(robot, xyz, grip=-1, speed=0.65, label='move'):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=['topview'])
+    s = state(obs)
+    pos = np.array([s[f'mocap_{a}'] for a in 'xyz'], dtype=float)
+    dest = np.array(xyz, dtype=float)
+    actions = []
+    while np.max(np.abs(dest-pos)) > 1e-7:
+        delta = np.clip((dest-pos)/.01, -speed, speed)
+        actions.append([*delta, grip])
+        pos += delta*.01
+    actions += [[0, 0, 0, grip]]*12
+    res = robot.submit('ee_delta', np.array(actions), dt=robot.spec()['control_dt'],
+                       cameras=['left','right','topview'], video='frames',
+                       note=label)
+    print(label, 'actions', len(actions), 'tcp', res.proprio[-1,:3].tolist(),
+          'opening', float(res.proprio[-1,3]), 'steps', res.meta['control_steps'],
+          'time_left', res.meta['time_left_s'], flush=True)
+    return res
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument('stage', choices=['approach', 'capture'])
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    r = Robot()
+    if args.stage == 'approach':
+        capture(r, 'before_approach')
+        move(r, [0.023, 0.4, 0.36], -1, label='raise_open')
+        move(r, [0.023, 0.57, 0.36], -1, label='over_blue_tip')
+        capture(r, 'above_tip')
+    else:
+        capture(r, 'current')
